explanation: Implemented all eight B05 diagram edits using the pinned sources. Added isolated analyze/materialize execution, shared change/source treemap projections, and panel-owned generated-context reuse. Existing attachment labels are preserved exactly, and edited diagrams remain within their reserved bounds. The new detail diagrams leave room for later workflow callers and presentation changes; later push integration and durable context libraries are not portrayed as implemented.
